schema.node.dat: tab-separated node_id,name,type[,comma-separated numeric attributes]; node types occupy contiguous ordered id ranges
schema.link.dat: tab-separated head_id,tail_id,raw relation_id,weight; metadata inferred from endpoint types; one sparse matrix per raw relation
schema.labels: tab-separated node_id,name,type,comma-separated classes; mask membership defines labeled splits

complete_definition: Entire published HGB dataset release, itself a benchmark subset of larger source databases. No analyst-selected subgraph for HGT controls.

documented_current_release.probe: HTTP200 HTML NC folder lists DBLP.zip/ACM.zip; DATA_ACCESS_PROBE.json

legacy_links: HGT README older Tsinghua folder; current common loader Tsinghua archive URLs return HTTP200 text/html under HEAD. Do not treat as successful archive retrieval.
conflicting_old_README_text: Later root README still describes half labels/xxx_full renaming/online submission. Current top update supersedes that claim, but actual current file layout/test-label provenance remains unverified; inspect manifest only under later dataset authorization.
split_source: Take author-provided TRAIN+VAL pool in label.dat; shuffle once, floor(0.2*n) validation and remainder train. Test membership from label.dat.test; no sampled test or new random graph partition. Saved paper describes24/6/70; integer counts require archive verification.
pairing: Produce each TRAIN/VAL split once per prebound master seed using a private NumPy RandomState and sorted masks; inject identical masks across all arms. Native HGB scripts do not bind the RNG themselves. SeHGNN does seed before split; remove its independent split reconstruction when supplying frozen paired masks.

source_schema_expectations.DBLP: 4 types A/P/T/V;6 directed raw relation schemas with distinct type pairs
source_schema_expectations.ACM: 4 types P/A/C/K;8 raw relations, including distinct PP and PP_r with identical endpoint types. Native HGT constructor collapses these; use unique raw-relation names
